Package com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.registry

Class ProviderRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.registry.ProviderRegistry
public class ProviderRegistry extends Object
Holds the set of InferenceProviders known to an OtterRuntime and resolves the right provider for a given ModelFormat — this is the "Provider SPI" / plugin-architecture piece of the runtime (Milestone 2).

Providers can be added in two ways:

  • discoverProviders() — scans the classpath via ServiceLoader, picking up every provider module present (otter-stream-onnx, otter-stream-tensorflow, ...)
  • register(InferenceProvider) — manual registration, useful for custom/internal providers that aren't shipped as a separate module

Thread-safe: backed by ConcurrentHashMap, safe to read from concurrently while a background thread registers new providers.

Since:
0.1.0

  • Method Details

    • discover

      public static ProviderRegistry discover()
      Creates a registry pre-populated via ServiceLoader discovery.
      Returns:
      a new registry with all classpath providers registered

    • discoverProviders

      public void discoverProviders()
      Scans the classpath for InferenceProvider implementations declared under META-INF/services/com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.spi.InferenceProvider and registers each of them. Safe to call multiple times (re-registration overwrites by provider id).

    • register

      public void register(InferenceProvider provider)
      Manually registers a provider, indexing it by every ModelFormat it supports. If multiple providers support the same format, they're tried in descending InferenceProvider.getPriority() order and the highest-priority one wins ties via first-registered.
      Parameters:
      provider - the provider to register

    • findProvider

      public Optional<InferenceProvider> findProvider(ModelFormat format)
      Finds the highest-priority provider registered for a given format.
      Parameters:
      format - the model format to resolve
      Returns:
      the matching provider, if any
